title: PDF OCR: Make Scanned PDFs Searchable, Free, No Upload
description: PDF OCR in your browser: turn a scan into a searchable PDF and a text file. Over 100 languages, no page limit. Free, nothing is uploaded.
promise: PDF OCR that turns a scanned document into a searchable PDF you can copy from, plus a plain text file. It runs on your device, with no page limit.
